text: The doctor provides excellent service, speaks kindly, and gives great advice. Plus, the price is very affordable, and they don't try to push package deals. restaurant_name: ตัวฝูคลินิก ฝังเข็ม ครอบแก้ว ยาจีน 多福堂 中医诊所 Duofu Acupuncture Clinic
text: This small but welcoming Traditional Chinese Medicine clinic is located within the Aemorn Hotel compound, near Wat Sri Boonruang, Mae Rim District, Chiang Mai. It's situated next to a physiotherapy clinic. The doctor provides excellent advice and offers acupuncture, cupping therapy, and Chinese herbal medicine at reasonable prices. This is a great option for those seeking alternative medical treatments and beauty care.

restaurant_name: ตัวฝูคลินิก ฝังเข็ม ครอบแก้ว ยาจีน 多福堂 中医诊所 Duofu Acupuncture Clinic
text: ☺️ If anyone is thinking about trying acupuncture, I highly recommend it. I've tried many treatments for 15 years – medication, injections, massage, traction, physical therapy – but nothing improved my lower back, neck, and stomach pain. I didn't try acupuncture until now because I was afraid of needles. But I didn't want to take medication anymore because it constantly irritated my stomach. People who were cured recommended acupuncture, so I decided to try it. It turned out not to be as painful as I thought, and not as dangerous as I imagined. I felt better from the first session. Since my condition was severe, I bought a 10-session course – it was amazing!😃 Even an ant bite hurts more, I'm telling you!😁 I've recommended acupuncture to everyone I know (people with pain, stress, insomnia, difficulty conceiving, those who want to look good and control their weight). I've recommended many friends and family members to see the doctor for 3-4 years now. The staff and the doctor are all wonderful. There's relaxing music. The prices aren't expensive here. Don't suffer any longer; try it, and you'll overcome your fear of needles forever.
